description: Run FlowPass against a public fixture or registered pack. Returns journey readiness, step verdicts, hat outputs, exclusions, and a stored report. Without fixture proof, returns a plan-only receipt instead of pretending a live journey ran.

fixture.description: Public fixture evidence for route, CTA, form, success, failure, navigation, handoff, side channels, timing, and accessibility.

generated_at.description: Optional ISO timestamp for reproducible fixture tests

pack_yaml.description: FlowPass YAML pack using plain-English steps

profile.description: Run profile label. Defaults to smoke.

target_sha.description: Optional PR or commit SHA for receipt staleness checks

target_url.description: Target URL for a one-off FlowPass run

name: flowpass_run
